mapper.select: SELECT owner_id, active_generation, build_generation, phase, scan_cursor, boundary_event_id, last_error_code FROM search_projection WHERE owner_id=#{owner}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_outbox WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND processed_at IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM knowledge_outbox WHERE owner_id=#{owner}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_projection(owner_id,active_generation,build_generation,phase,scan_cursor,boundary_event_id,last_error_code,updated_at) VALUES(#{owner},NULL,#{generation},'SCANNING',NULL,#{boundary},NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE build_generation=#{generation},phase='SCANNING',scan_cursor=NULL, boundary_event_id=#{boundary},last_error_code=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE search_projection SET scan_cursor=#{cursor},phase=#{phase},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND build_generation=#{generation}

UPDATE search_projection SET active_generation=#{generation},build_generation=NULL,phase='IDLE',scan_cursor=NULL, last_error_code=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND build_generation=#{generation}
UPDATE search_projection SET last_error_code=NULL WHERE owner_id=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM knowledge_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND current_version_id IS NOT NULL AND id > #{cursor} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.id,i.owner_id,i.kind,i.status,i.metadata_revision,v.id version_id,v.version_number,v.title,v.body,v.source_type, COALESCE(o.revision,0) organization_revision,COALESCE(o.aliases_json,JSON_ARRAY()) aliases_json, COALESCE(o.tags_json,JSON_ARRAY()) tags_json FROM knowledge_item i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.id=i.current_version_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.owner_id=i.owner_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_organization o ON o.item_id=i.id AND o.owner_id=i.owner_id WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT id,item_id FROM knowledge_outbox WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND processed_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_outbox SET processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id IN #{id}
